attr.title: DaytonaArm (Daytona USA)
attr.desc: Native ARM64 / OpenGL ES 2.0 handheld port of daytona-arcade-recomp (Sega Model 2 static recompilation for Daytona USA Deluxe '93 and Revision A 1994), engineered for Anbernic RG34XX (Allwinner H700 / Mali-G31) and compatible PortMaster AArch64 handhelds. Bring your own MAME ROM sets and PC-built cache modules.
attr.inst:
1. Copy your own legal MAME ROM archive(s) daytona.zip (Revision A, 1994) and/or daytona93.zip (Deluxe '93) into ports/daytonaarm/roms/.
2. On a PC, run tools/build-arm64-cache.sh to statically recompile your ROM set(s) into native Cortex-A53 shared modules (cache/daytona-aarch64.so and/or cache/daytona93-aarch64.so) and copy them into ports/daytonaarm/cache/.
3. Launch Daytona USA.sh (or a direct ROM launcher). Press Start+Select (or Menu) in-game for Options, Controls, and Hold Test Button (set Cabinet to SINGLE once in Test Mode).
